name: PUPPY
identity_source: assets/reference/master_reference.png (USER PROVIDED - always wins over any text below)

text_defaults_if_reference_is_silent.species: cute fluffy chibi puppy, cartoon (not realistic)
text_defaults_if_reference_is_silent.fur: warm golden with cream chest, muzzle and paw tips
text_defaults_if_reference_is_silent.eyes: large, round, glossy, expressive; copy exact colour and highlight layout from the reference; never change
text_defaults_if_reference_is_silent.ears: floppy, rounded, slightly darker golden than the body
text_defaults_if_reference_is_silent.body: round and fluffy, tiny paws, big fluffy tail; head is about 55% of total body height

style_lock: Cute chibi cartoon puppy, game-sprite style. Match the reference character EXACTLY: same face, same eye shape and colour, same ear shape, same fur colours and cream markings, same proportions (large head, tiny paws, big fluffy tail). Soft cel-shading with gentle gradients, clean warm-brown outline of uniform thickness (about 3 px at 384 px), warm pastel palette, no realistic fur texture, no photorealism. Background: flat solid pure green #00FF00 only, no floor, no ground shadow, no gradient, no text, no watermark. One single character, centred, entire body visible with at least 8% empty margin on every side. No green anywhere on the character. No props unless the pose says so.

symmetry.mirror_ok: UNDECIDED - agent inspects the reference in Phase A and asks the user; if any marking is asymmetric set false and generate *_left variants separately
symmetry.note: Left-facing walk/run is the mirrored strip only when mirror_ok is true

reference_image_roles: Image 1 = identity truth for this camera. Image 2 = secondary identity check. Image 3 (frames after the first) = the previous approved frame of the same animation: keep identical scale, framing and ground position.
model_sheet_deliverables: master_front.png: sitting, front view, neutral smile
master_three_quarter.png: sitting, three-quarter view facing right
master_side_right.png: standing, side view facing right
expressions_sheet.png: 3x3 grid (happy, sad, surprised, sleepy, kiss, eyes-closed bliss, tongue-out, scared, curious)
colour_tokens_source: assets/spec/palette.json (derived by tools/extract_palette.py from the approved master_front.png; do not invent colours)
